# REVÉLAT

> REVÉLAT is a live-auction mobile app for fashion. Sellers model their clothing and accessories on camera; on-device vision AI recognizes each item against the seller's catalog and automatically opens bidding the moment it's worn — and closes it when they move on. Buyers watch items modeled live and bid in real time. Think a live runway show where everything on the model is for sale, with no auctioneer required.

This site is the pre-launch waitlist. The product is a cross-platform app — iOS, Android, and web (currently onboarding founding sellers).

## Core concept
- The seller performs; the auction runs itself. Vision recognition opens an auction when an item is worn and closes it when it's removed.
- Bidding is real-time and race-free, synchronized across all viewers, with anti-snipe protection.
- The full transaction (watch → bid → win → pay → ship) happens inside the live stream.

## Who it's for
- Sellers: resellers, vintage curators, and boutique owners who want to sell live without manually tagging products or running an auction by hand.
- Buyers: people who want the energy of a live drop with the fairness of a real auction, and who want to see garments worn and in motion before bidding.

## Key pages
- [Home / Waitlist](/): product explanation, how it works, and email signup for early access.

## How it works
1. A seller wears an item live on camera.
2. Vision AI matches it to their uploaded catalog and opens the auction automatically.
3. Viewers bid in real time while the item is on screen.
4. When the seller moves on, the auction closes and the next item begins.

## Status
- Pre-launch. Onboarding founding sellers (reduced fees for life for the first cohort), opening to buyers shortly after.
